page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre above two rules. Below it two columns of index entries, left and right. Below the columns a closing line "Finis Indicum." with a small printer's ornament (crown and sceptre-like device) to its right. No page number, no catchword, no signature.
page.notes: Two columns read left then right; the left column runs Saxonica with its sub-entries, the right column runs Scotica, Scythica, Sclavonica, Suecica, Syriaca. The sub-entry lines are set in italic and indented. The "Finis Indicum." line is set in a larger bold type. A small ornament (crown with sceptre-like device) sits at the right and is not text. Some specks and a diagonal rule/stain lie in the middle of the page; not printed text. The "Sauromatica 55" numeral is read as 55 from "5§" and may be 55 or 53.
